arxiv-2204-11905.title: A linear program for testing nonclassicality and an open-source implementation
arxiv-2204-11905.creator: John H. Selby, Elie Wolfe, David Schmid, Ana Belén Sainz, Vinicius P. Rossi
arxiv-2204-11905.description: Abstract A well motivated method for demonstrating that an experiment resists any classical explanation is to show that its statistics violate generalized noncontextuality. We here formulate this problem as a linear program and provide an open-source implementation of it which tests whether or not any given prepare-measure experiment is classically-explainable in this sense.

arxiv-2206-02860.title: Tunneling in rippled graphene superlattice with spin dependence and a mass term
arxiv-2206-02860.creator: Jaouad El-hassouny, Ahmed Jellal, El Houssine Atmani
arxiv-2206-02860.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jaouad El-hassouny, Ahmed Jellal, El Houssine Atmani. The insertion of the band gap Δ \Delta in the rippled graphene superlattice leads to new outcomes, as demonstrated. The essential thing is the appearance of opposite-spin transmissions, which increase with Δ \Delta and vanish without it. Furthermore, compared to the Δ = 0 \Delta=0 scenario, the duration of the suppression of the transmission with the same spin is longer, with many peaks. The maximum value of transmissions with the same spin declines and remains around unity.

arxiv-2209-15162.title: Linearly Mapping from Image to Text Space
arxiv-2209-15162.creator: Jack Merullo, Louis Castricato, Carsten Eickhoff, Ellie Pavlick
arxiv-2209-15162.description: Abstract The extent to which text-only language models (LMs) learn to represent features of the non-linguistic world is an open question. Prior work has shown that pretrained LMs can be taught to caption images when a vision model’s parameters are optimized to encode images in the language space.

arxiv-2304-14253.title: The observed number counts in luminosity distance space
arxiv-2304-14253.creator: and Chris Clarkson
arxiv-2304-14253.description: Abstract Next generation surveys will provide us with an unprecedented number of detections of supernovae Type Ia and gravitational wave merger events. Cross-correlations of such objects offer novel and powerful insights into the large-scale distribution of matter in the universe.

arxiv-2402-15022.title: Moving higher-order Taylor approximations method for smooth constrained minimization problems Thanks: Submitted to the editors
arxiv-2402-15022.creator: Yassine Nabou, Ion Necoara
arxiv-2402-15022.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop a higher-order method for solving composite (non)convex minimization problems with smooth (non)convex functional constraints. At each iteration, our method approximates the smooth part of the objective function and of the constraints by higher-order Taylor approximations, leading to a moving Taylor approximation method (MTA).

arxiv-2405-03062.title: Cavity QED systems for steady-state sources of Wigner-negative light
arxiv-2405-03062.creator: Alex Elliott 1,2, Scott Parkins 1,2
arxiv-2405-03062.description: Abstract We present a theoretical investigation of optical cavity QED systems, as described by the driven, open Jaynes-Cummings model and some of its variants, as potential sources of steady-state Wigner-negative light. We consider temporal modes in the continuous output field from the cavity and demonstrate pronounced negativity in their Wigner distributions for experimentally-relevant parameter regimes.

arxiv-2412-02605.title: Interpretable Company Similarity with Sparse Autoencoders Thanks: This work appeared as a preprint on arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.02605 . Code and data are available at: https://github.com/FlexCode29/company_similarity_sae . Alternative email: marcomolinari4@gmail.com
arxiv-2412-02605.creator: Marco Molinari, Victor Shao, Luca Imeneo, Mateusz Mikolajczak, Vladimir Tregubiak, Abhimanyu Pandey, Sebastião Kuznetsov Ryder Torres Pereira
arxiv-2412-02605.description: Abstract Determining company similarity is a vital task in finance, underpinning risk management, hedging, and portfolio diversification. Practitioners often rely on sector and industry classifications such as SIC and GICS codes to gauge similarity, the former is used by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), and the latter widely used by the investment community.

arxiv-2502-11360.title: GeoDANO: Geometric VLM with Domain Agnostic Vision Encoder
arxiv-2502-11360.creator: Seunghyuk Cho, Zhenyue Qin, Yang Liu, Youngbin Choi, Seungbeom Lee, Dongwoo Kim
arxiv-2502-11360.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Seunghyuk Cho, Zhenyue Qin, Yang Liu, Youngbin Choi, Seungbeom Lee, Dongwoo Kim. We introduce GeoDANO, a geometric vision-language model (VLM) with a domain-agnostic vision encoder, for solving plane geometry problems. Although VLMs have been employed for solving geometry problems, their ability to recognize geometric features remains insufficiently analyzed. To address this gap, we propose a benchmark that evaluates the recognition of visual geometric features, including primitives such as dots and lines, and relations such as orthogonality.

arxiv-2504-07798.title: Mechanical Amorphization of Glass-Forming Systems Induced by Oscillatory Deformation: The Energy Absorption and Efficiency Control
arxiv-2504-07798.creator: Baoshuang Shang #, Xinxin Li #, Pengfei Guan, Weihua Wang
arxiv-2504-07798.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Baoshuang Shang #, Xinxin Li #, Pengfei Guan, Weihua Wang. The kinetic process of mechanical amorphization plays a central role in tailoring material properties. Therefore, a quantitative understanding of how this process depends on loading parameters is critical for optimizing mechanical amorphization and tuning material performance.

arxiv-2601-21473.title: ScaleSim: Serving Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation with Invocation Distance-Based Memory Management
arxiv-2601-21473.creator: Zaifeng Pan, Yipeng Shen, Zhengding Hu, Zhuang Wang, Aninda Manocha, Zheng Wang, Zhongkai Yu, Yue Guan, Yufei Ding
arxiv-2601-21473.description: Abstract LLM-based multi-agent simulations are increasingly adopted across application domains, but remain difficult to scale due to GPU memory pressure. Each agent maintains private GPU-resident states, including models, prefix caches, and adapters, which quickly exhaust device memory as the agent count grows. We identify two key properties of these workloads: sparse agent activation and estimable agent invocation orders.

europmc-pmc5353725.creator: Maes T, Jessop R, Wellner N, Haupt K, Mayes AG.
europmc-pmc5353725.description: A new approach is presented for analysis of microplastics in environmental samples, based on selective fluorescent staining using Nile Red (NR), followed by density-based extraction and filtration. The dye adsorbs onto plastic surfaces and renders them fluorescent when...

plos-pone-0010997.creator: Viviane Hénaux, Michael D. Samuel, Christine M. Bunck
plos-pone-0010997.description: PLOS ONE research article. However, understanding the epidemic dynamics of highly pathogenic (HPAI) viruses remains challenging because they have rarely bee

pmc-10648514.title: A Gastroenterologist’s Guide to Care Transitions in Cystic Fibrosis from Pediatrics to Adult Care
pmc-10648514.creator: Dhiren Patel, Michelle Baliss, Pavithra Saikumar, Laith Numan, Jeffrey Teckman, Christine Hachem, Francesco Amati
pmc-10648514.description: Cystic Fibrosis is a chronic disease affecting multiple systems, including the GI tract. Clinical manifestation in patients can start as early as infancy and vary across different age groups. With the advent of new, highly effective modulators, the life expectancy of PwCF has improved significantly.

pmc-11438019.title: Single-cell sequencing to multi-omics: technologies and applications
pmc-11438019.creator: Xiangyu Wu, Xin Yang, Yunhan Dai, Zihan Zhao, Junmeng Zhu, Hongqian Guo, Rong Yang
pmc-11438019.description: Cells, as the fundamental units of life, contain multidimensional spatiotemporal information. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is revolutionizing biomedical science by analyzing cellular state and intercellular heterogeneity. Undoubtedly, single-cell transcriptomics has emerged as one of the most vibrant research fields today. With the optimization and innovation of single-cell sequencing technologies, the intricate multidimensional details concealed within cells are gradually unveiled.

pmc-11565348.title: The use of electromagnetic navigation bronchoscopy-guided microwave ablation in patients with multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules: a retrospective study of 26 cases
pmc-11565348.creator: Siwei Wang, Chi Su, Jing Li, Na Yin, Chunpei Wu, Rong Gao, Shuai Zhang, Xiaojun Wang, Zhenzhong Lin, Dongxue Li, Jingwen Hu, Ming Li
pmc-11565348.description: BackgroundTo treat multiple bilateral ground-glass opacities (GGOs), surgical treatments and electromagnetic navigation bronchoscopy (ENB)-guided ablation therapy are recommended therapeutic measures. However, the differences between bilateral and unilateral ablation, with or without surgery, remain unknown. This study aims to evaluate the differences in efficacy among various strategies.

pmc-11630699.title: Contribution of Scalp Regions to Machine Learning-Based Classification of Dementia Utilizing Resting-State qEEG Signals
pmc-11630699.creator: Chanda Simfukwe, Seong Soo A An, Young Chul Youn
pmc-11630699.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeThis study aims to investigate using eyes-open (EO) and eyes-closed (EC) resting-state EEG data to diagnose cognitive impairment using machine learning methods, enhancing timely intervention and cost-effectiveness in dementia research.Participants and MethodsA total of 890 participants aged 40–90 were included in the study, comprising 269 healthy controls (HC), 356 individuals with mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and 265 with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) from a cohort study. Resting-state EEG (rEEG) signals were recorded and transformed into relative power spectral density (PSD) data for analysis.

pmc-11759107.title: RELATIONSHIP OF MASTOID PNEUMATIZATION AND AGE WITH COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY MEASURED SPHENOID SINUS VOLUME
pmc-11759107.creator: Rozita Gulić, Andrej Šribar, Davor Vagić
pmc-11759107.description: SUMMARYThe aim was to measure sphenoid sinus volume on the basis of computed tomography data post processing and to investigate the possible relationship with age, gender and mastoid pneumatization. Sphenoid sinus volume was measured using the semi-automatic post processing algorithm of MSCT DICOM datasets of 66 patients. There were 35 female and 31 male subjects.

pmc-12472227.title: Next-Generation Wastewater-Based Epidemiology: Green Automation for Detecting 69 Multiclass Pharmaceutical and Personal Care Products in Wastewater Using 96-Well Plate Solid-Phase Extraction by LC-MS/MS
pmc-12472227.creator: Bhaskar Karubothula, Veera Venkataramana Kota, Dnyaneshwar Shinde, Raghu Tadala, Vishnu Cheerala, Samara Bin Salem, Wael Faroug Elamin, Grzegorz Brudecki, Hiroyuki Kataoka
pmc-12472227.description: Conventional methods for detecting pharmaceutical and personal care products (PPCPs) in environmental samples are complex, resource-intensive, and not sustainable. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate an automated sample preparation approach using the Biomek i7 Workstation to analyze 69 PPCPs in wastewater, with the objective to improve monitoring of public health and environmental protection.

pmc-12595999.title: “The Idea of Being Without It is Frightening”. Uncertainty and Psychological Dependency for Patients Using Immuno‐, Biological, or Precision Therapies: A Qualitative Study
pmc-12595999.creator: J. Lecouturier, L. Crowe, M. C. Brown, A. Greystoke, A. Bojke, R. Bojke, J. Richardson, M. Wells, E. Ezeala, L. Carter, L. Sharp, A. Todd
pmc-12595999.description: BackgroundIBP therapies (immunotherapies, biologics and precision therapies) have had a significant impact on cancer survival. They differ from conventional cancer treatments in that they may be used long term and have less predictable adverse effects. We aimed to explore the psychological impact of IBP therapies from the perspectives of those living with advanced cancer.

pmc-12609986.title: Reproducing Cold-Chain Conditions in Real Time Using a Controlled Peltier-Based Climate System
pmc-12609986.creator: Javier M. Garrido-López, Alfonso P. Ramallo-González, Manuel Jiménez-Buendía, Ana Toledo-Moreo, Roque Torres-Sánchez
pmc-12609986.description: Temperature excursions during refrigerated transport strongly affect the quality and shelf life of perishable food, yet reproducing realistic, time-varying cold-chain temperature histories in the laboratory remains challenging. In this study, we present a compact, portable climate chamber driven by Peltier modules and an identification-guided control architecture designed to reproduce real refrigerated-truck temperature histories with high fidelity.

pmc-12753717.title: Rapid virus-free production of recombinant yellow fever virus envelope protein and its in-depth biophysical analysis
pmc-12753717.creator: Luca Schelle, Wolfgang Kuttenlochner, Victoria Sanchez, Barbara Steigenberger, Katja Finkl, Marius Schmid, Celine Douat, Einar Halldorsson, Maren Schubert, Sabine Suppmann
pmc-12753717.description: The aim of this study was to develop a rapid and easy-to-adapt protocol for recombinant production of Orthoflavivirus proteins. We introduced the new-generation pOpiE2 vector for virus-free transient transfection of Trichopluisa ni High Five insect cells to produce the envelope protein ectodomain of Yellow Fever Virus Asibi and 17D strains.

pmc-12970969.title: Adult dengue vaccination in a low transmission setting: A modelling study in Singapore
pmc-12970969.creator: Abhishek Senapati, Tun-Linn Thein, Yee-Sin Leo, Hannah Eleanor Clapham
pmc-12970969.description: Dengue virus, with all four serotypes in cocirculation, has created significant epidemiological and economic burdens in Singapore. Despite integrated vector control programs, the magnitude and frequency of dengue outbreaks has increased over the last few decades, which highlights the limits of existing strategies.

pmc-12992929.title: Long-term treatment of early Alzheimer’s disease with donanemab
pmc-12992929.creator: Vincenzo Solfrizzi, Bruno P Imbimbo
pmc-12992929.description: ce of clinical benefit after treatment discontinuation, and a safety profile that appears broadly consistent with that observed during the parent trial. Despite these encouraging results, several unresolved issues warrant careful consideration. First, the population eligible for donanemab treatment remains numerically very small when compared with the overall number of patients with early Alzheimer’s disease (AD).

pmc-13417964.creator: Mengting Xu, Zili Zhang, Xiao Hu, Rong Zheng

pmc-13435230.title: Graph designs for deep learning–based multi-omics integration
pmc-13435230.creator: Muhtasim Noor Alif, Khandakar Tanvir Ahmed, Sudipto Baul, Wei Zhang
pmc-13435230.description: Modern sequencing technologies can now capture multiple omic layers from the same biological system, but integrating these views into a coherent model is far from trivial. Graph-based deep learning has become an attractive strategy because it can represent complex molecular interactions and sample relationships in a flexible way.

pmc-13688971.title: The effect of sleep quality and depressive symptoms on the relationship between burnout and health-related productivity loss in nurses working in intensive care: a cross-sectional study from the Chinese nurses’ health cohort study (TARGET)
pmc-13688971.creator: Xueyan Liu, Juan Kong, Xiaodong Yuan, Qian Ma, Zhen Zhang, Patricia M Davidson, Yingjuan Cao
pmc-13688971.description: BackgroundBurnout is highly prevalent among ICU nurses and compromises physical and psychological well-being, leading to productivity loss. However, limited evidence exists regarding the pathways through which burnout influences productivity, particularly the role of sleep disturbance and depression.AimFew studies have examined the mechanisms through which burnout affects health-related productivity in intensive care unit (ICU) nurses.
